title: SAVE JAMES — Braun-Admin-Mediated Memory Capture Extension

core_upgrade.old_search_model: Find a player-visible terminal command that copies James memory to a chip.
core_upgrade.new_search_model: Use Stanislaus Braun's demonstrated privileged control plane, because public Version Control is read-only while Braun has remote pod privilege, per-user memory override, subject alteration and custody of the mem-chip class.
core_upgrade.reason: Pinkerton stole from Braun a physical mem chip already containing an unknown person's memories; therefore some Vault112/Braun-side process had previously represented memory state on a portable carrier.
